scripts.render: remotion render Episode out/episode.mp4 && npm run speed
scripts.render:clips: for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do remotion render Clip$i out/clip$i.mp4; done
scripts.speed: remotion ffmpeg -y -itsscale 0.9090909 -i out/episode.mp4 -i out/episode.mp4 -map 0:v -map 1:a -af atempo=1.1 -r 24 -c:v libx264 -crf 22 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart rendu-final.mp4
